title: Airbnb Metric4 High Value Outliers
dataSources: Airbnb bookings (`airbnb:booking`), Vrbo reservations (`vrbo:reservation`), Airbnb payouts (`airbnb:payout`), and guest reviews (`guest:review`).
app: Airbnb booking exports, Vrbo reservation webhooks, Airbnb payout statements, guest review logs, and turnover checklists streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=airbnb:metric4 value=*
| eventstats perc90(value) as p90, perc10(value) as p10
| where value>=p90 OR value<=p10
| table _time source_id value p90 p10
description: Surfaces the highest and lowest value outliers in airbnb metric4 (4) events.
value: Tail events often explain spikes in cost, effort, or risk that averages hide.
implementation: Compute percentile bands on `value` and review extreme airbnb metric4 (4) records.
visualization: Scatter plot of value with percentile bands.
grandmaExplanation: It lets you the unusually high or low value moments in your airbnb metric4 (4) history.
